polity-13.title: Centre State and Inter State Relations
polity-13.quality_review: Deep-content reconstruction from repaired Core, 11 verified PYQs, current official controls and marks-scaled answer guidance.

panels.title: Four-dimensional constitutional map
panels.full_text:
CENTRE-STATE AND INTER-STATE RELATIONS
  +-- LEGISLATIVE: Articles 245-255 and Seventh Schedule
  +-- ADMINISTRATIVE: Articles 256-263
  +-- FINANCIAL: Articles 265-293 plus 246A / 269A / 279A
  +-- INTER-STATE / MARKET: Articles 261-263 and 301-307

METHOD: identify field -> constitutional route -> check -> remedy.

panels.title: Legislative competence and State-field entry
panels.full_text:
COMPETENCE FIRST
Article 245 reach -> Article 246 lists -> Article 248 residue
  +-- Union 100 | State 61 | Concurrent 52
  +-- Article 246A: special GST competence

PARLIAMENT IN STATE FIELD
249 Rajya Sabha | 250 Emergency | 252 State request | 253 treaty | 356 breakdown
Each route has a separate trigger, duration and amendment consequence.

panels.title: Doctrines, repugnancy and State Bills
panels.full_text:
TRUE NATURE -> ENTRY -> RECONCILIATION -> CONFLICT
pith and substance -> harmonious construction -> Article 254 repugnancy
*M. Karunanidhi* (1979): real, direct and irreconcilable Concurrent-field conflict

STATE BILL CONTROLS
prior presidential sanction != Governor reservation under Article 200
Article 201 presidential consideration; no automatic assent after State reconsideration.

panels.title: Administrative cooperation and central agencies
panels.full_text:
ARTICLES 256-257
State compliance + no impediment -> bounded Union directions
ARTICLES 258 / 258A -> reciprocal entrustment
ARTICLE 312 -> Rajya Sabha route for IAS / IPS / Indian Forest Service

CBI / DSPE ACT
State consent for ordinary operation; Articles 32/226 court orders remain possible
2024 West Bengal ruling: Article 131 suit maintainable at preliminary stage, merits open.

panels.title: Articles 355-365 and judicial limits
panels.full_text:
DUTY -> REMEDY -> TEMPORARY CONSEQUENCE
Article 355 Union duty
Article 356 exceptional proclamation + Parliament + review
Article 357 temporary exercise of State legislative power
Article 360 separate financial-emergency route
Article 365 non-compliance may supply material, never automatic rule

*State of Rajasthan* (1977) -> review not wholly excluded
*S.R. Bommai* (1994) -> federalism, review and floor-test discipline.

panels.title: Fiscal architecture from tax to borrowing
panels.full_text:
ARTICLE 265: authority of law
268 / 269 / 269A -> assigned and apportioned revenue
270 -> divisible pool | 271 -> Union surcharge outside sharing
275 -> constitutional grants | 282 -> any-public-purpose grants
280 -> Finance Commission | 292 / 293 -> borrowing
285 / 289 -> reciprocal property and income tax immunities with exceptions.

panels.title: Fiscal evolution, Sixteenth Finance Commission and GST
panels.full_text:
PLAN ERA -> FC / GST / NITI ERA
Planning Commission discretion -> NITI has no devolution power
Sixteenth Finance Commission 2026-31 -> 41% vertical share
horizontal weights include income distance, demography, ecology and GDP contribution

GST: Articles 246A + 269A + 279A
Union one-third votes | States two-thirds | three-fourths decision threshold
*Mohit Minerals* (2022): Council recommendations are recommendatory, not binding.

panels.title: River-water dispute route and jurisdiction
panels.full_text:
ARTICLE 262 + 1956 ACT
negotiation -> dispute-specific tribunal -> publication -> implementation
Parliament may exclude court jurisdiction over the defined water dispute
Article 131 does not displace the special Article 262 statutory bar

CURRENT CONTROL
2019 Amendment Bill lapsed with the Seventeenth Lok Sabha
A revised permanent-tribunal proposal is not enacted law
Cauvery implementation uses the 2018 Scheme and management institutions.

panels.title: Intergovernmental forums and current operation
panels.full_text:
ARTICLE 263 INTER-STATE COUNCIL
President establishes when public interest requires; inquiry, discussion, recommendation
1990 presidential order | PM chair | advisory

ZONAL COUNCILS
Five statutory councils under States Reorganisation Act 1956 | Home Minister chair
NEC is separate under 1971 Act, not a sixth Zonal Council
2026 official activity: Central, Northern, Eastern and Southern zonal mechanisms.

panels.title: Common market, recognition and layered regulation
panels.full_text:
ARTICLE 261 -> recognition of public acts, records and proceedings; civil execution
ARTICLES 301-304 -> free trade with bounded regulation and non-discrimination
*Jindal Stainless* (2016): no tax-free promise; Article 304(a) targets discrimination

MINOR MINERALS
MMDR Section 3(e) Centre notifies category
Section 15 States make concession rules -> layered power, not State exclusion.

panels.title: Commissions, eleven PYQs and Prelims firewalls
panels.full_text:
REFORM EVIDENCE
Rajamannar -> State autonomy | Sarkaria -> cooperative safeguards | Punchhi -> modern machinery

ELEVEN PYQ ROUTES
2019 doctrines | 2020 centralisation | 2021 CBI | 2022 parties/autonomy
2023 Article 356 + GST | 2024 relations reform + list trap
2025 fiscal federalism + constitutional-body + minor-mineral traps

FIREWALLS: Article 365 is not automatic; GST is not a Concurrent-list tax entry;
Zonal Councils are statutory; the 2019 water Bill is not law.

panels.title: Marks-scaled answer spine and qualified verdict
panels.full_text:
10 MARKS: definition -> 2-3 anchors -> qualification -> verdict
15 MARKS: thesis -> dimensions -> evidence/case -> counterpoint -> reform
20 MARKS: legislative + administrative + fiscal + inter-State -> diagnosis -> reform

EVIDENCE CHAIN
claim -> Article/institution -> operation -> State/Union counterpoint -> commission remedy

VERDICT
Strong Union power is constitutionally bounded; durable relations require consultation
before compulsion, predictable finance, shared data and reviewable discretion.
